run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:50:36Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is caused by a bad configuration value in the shipping Deployment: its container env QUOTE_ADDR is set to "quote:0000" instead of a valid quote-service address, so the shipping service cannot build a valid outbound URI. Shipping's own spans show the failure directly — the client span "POST " on shipping (service version 2.1.3) fails with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) and its server span /get-quote returns "Internal Server Error" (500). Same-trace evidence shows this propagating up: checkout's PlaceOrder fails with gRPC code 13 ("shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"), frontend's POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500, and frontend-proxy ingress returns 500. The transition tracks a shipping Deployment rollout at 00:49:16–00:49:23Z (new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8, old pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q killed, Deployment generation 2 / revision 2), after which the quote service stopped receiving requests (its last "Calculated quote" log line is 00:49:20.125Z and all of its span rates are 0), even though its endpoint and pod are healthy. Frontend error rate was 0 at 00:49:36Z and non-zero from the 00:51:36Z sample onward, following the rollout. The shipping pod itself is Running/Ready with 0 restarts and keeps logging "Requesting quote", so this is a configuration fault, not a crash; cart, currency, payment, product-catalog, accounting and flagd-injected faults showed no errors.

claims.text: Frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate went from 0 at the 00:49:36Z sample to 0.68 at 00:51:36Z, 1.81 at 00:53:36Z and a peak of 2.34 spans/s at 00:55:36Z in the sampled series, i.e. the error onset follows the 00:49Z shipping rollout; the alert fired at 00:50:36Z.

At 01:00Z the frontend errors were concentrated on the checkout route: frontend spans POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder each showed STATUS_CODE_ERROR at about 0.678 spans/s, while frontend GET, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/data, GET /api/data and the ad/cart client spans were 0.

The otel-demo Deployment shipping sets container env QUOTE_ADDR to the value "quote:0000" (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, SHIPPING_PORT 8080), and the running pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn carries the same QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" env value.

Shipping's own spans show the failure mechanism: the /get-quote span of service shipping (2.1.3) carries otel.status_code ERROR with description "Internal Server Error", and its child span "POST " carries the error description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))" with a 10 us duration, i.e. the outbound quote request never forms a valid URI.

In the same traces the error propagates upward: checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span fails with otel.status_code ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and message "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"; frontend spans POST /api/checkout and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout return http.status_code 500; frontend-proxy ingress / router frontend egress and load-generator POST also record HTTP 500.

Error rates at 01:00Z: shipping /get-quote and "POST " at 0.649 spans/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and HTTP POST at 0.647 spans/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR, while checkout's CartService/GetCart, CurrencyService/Convert and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans report rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and currency Currency/Convert is otel.status_code OK.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo show a shipping Deployment rollout: pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn Scheduled 00:49:16Z, image already present 00:49:21Z, container Created 00:49:21Z, Started 00:49:23Z; ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 SuccessfulCreate, old pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q Killing and ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 SuccessfulDelete at 00:49:23Z; Deployment shipping ScalingReplicaSet up 0->1 and down 1->0.

Deployment shipping is at metadata.generation 2 with status.observedGeneration 2, updatedReplicas 1, revision annotation "2" and Helm annotations meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo; its Progressing condition lastUpdateTime is 2026-11-18T00:49:23Z, consistent with one template change taking effect at the rollout.

The quote service stopped receiving requests at the rollout: the newest log line of pod quote-6b5877698d-6spfl is "Calculated quote" at 2026-11-18T00:49:20.125Z, and at 01:00Z all quote spans (calculate-quote, {closure}, POST /getquote) have rate 0 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the quote Service endpoint still lists pod quote-6b5877698d-6spfl at port 8080.

The shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no last termination state, and its container keeps writing normal "Requesting quote" log lines through 00:58:17Z, so it is not crashed or restarting.

Other services did not show errors in the same window: accounting, cart, payment, email (no error series returned) and currency (Currency/Convert STATUS_CODE_OK) error rates were 0, and the only nonzero per-service error rates were frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout and shipping.

The flagd-based fault injection flags are not enabling any fault: in ConfigMap flagd-config the flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure all have defaultVariant "off" (variants off=false/0), so no flagd fault explains the checkout failures.

Rejected: the quote service itself failing. quote produced no error spans, all of its operation rates were 0 and its own logs stop at 00:49:20.125Z because no request reached it, and its Service endpoint still resolves to a running pod on port 8080; the observable failure is in shipping's URI construction before any call is made.

Rejected: a resource shortage, crash or eviction of shipping as the cause. The new shipping pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts and no last termination reason, and the only otel-demo Pod events in the window are Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/Killing from the rollout, with no Evicted, OOMKilled or FailedScheduling event for shipping.

Fix the shipping Deployment configuration: set QUOTE_ADDR to a valid quote service address (the quote Service listens on port 8080, so "quote:8080") and roll the Deployment, then confirm shipping's "POST quote" spans succeed and quote logs resume.

Review the Helm values/change pipeline for release otel-demo that produced shipping revision 2 (QUOTE_ADDR "quote:0000") and add address/port validation so a malformed dependency address cannot be rolled out.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available, so who changed the shipping Deployment env and the exact instant the value "quote:0000" was written are not observed; the change time is inferred only from the rollout events at 00:49:16–00:49:23Z, Deployment generation 2 and the quote traffic stopping at 00:49:20Z.

The previous shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q was deleted, so its QUOTE_ADDR value and image digest cannot be read; queries for kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="otel-demo"} and kube_pod_container_info{pod="shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn"} returned no series in the window, so ReplicaSet ownership and digest comparison could not be verified from kube-state-metrics.
frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-lmznt returned no container log lines in the window (bytes_read 0), so the frontend's application log text could not corroborate the 500s that its spans show.

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the alert's exact expression, threshold and firing history could not be checked; the alert description value 1.777 was taken from the alert labels only.
shipping container logs were limited to the newest 100 of 339 lines (00:55:24–00:58:17Z), so earlier lines around the 00:49Z restart were not read.

checkout's error text names "email service", but no email error spans or error series were observed in this window and the provenance of that wrapper message in checkout's code could not be verified from available data.

kubernetes_jq_query on the shipping Deployment with container env extraction returned INVALID_PARAMS twice before succeeding with a narrower selector, so an early env read of all deployments was not obtained.
next_steps: Restore a valid QUOTE_ADDR (for example quote:8080) in Deployment otel-demo/shipping and roll it out, then watch shipping /get-quote, checkout PlaceOrder and frontend POST /api/checkout error rates return to baseline.
Consult Helm release history / CI records for release otel-demo and Deployment shipping revision 2 to identify who introduced QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" and add a config validation gate.
Add a deployment-level check or alert on malformed dependency addresses (invalid URI) so shipping fails visibly at startup rather than silently returning 500 to checkout.
